title: Thrust Reverser Translating Sleeve — Installation of the Aft Seal and Deployment Timing Check
abstract: Installation of the aft seal and heat shield on a translating sleeve with the shim selection that sets seal compression, followed by the on-wing deployment and stow timing check.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the aft seal and the heat shield on a translating sleeve, to select the shims that set the seal compression, and to do the deployment and stow timing check after the reverser is refitted.
sections.job_setup_note: Seal compression is set by shim selection against the land measurements taken at removal, not by tightening the fasteners. Over-compression closes the leakage path but shortens the seal life and produces a stow time outside the limits. The retaining fasteners are single use. The timing check is done on wing after the reverser is refitted, and the limits are unchanged by the seal standard.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm that the liner survey passed and that the blocker door land is at the required profile. 2. Clean the seal land and the fastener holes. 3. Select the shims for the measured land dimension at each of the four stations. CAUTION: DO NOT SET SEAL COMPRESSION BY TIGHTENING THE FASTENERS. OVER-COMPRESSION GIVES A STOW TIME OUTSIDE THE LIMITS AND SHORTENS THE SEAL LIFE. 4. Put the seal and its carrier in position with the selected shims. 5. Install new retaining fasteners and tighten them in the sequence given in the figure to the stated torque. 6. Confirm the seal contact through the full simulated sleeve travel on the stand. 7. Install the heat shield, lifting it square onto the sleeve, and fit new fasteners. 8. Confirm the heat shield covers the liner edge with no gap at any station. 9. Remove the sleeve from the stand and refit the reverser to the engine. 10. Do the deployment and stow timing check on wing. WARNING: KEEP THE REVERSER DEPLOYMENT AREA CLEAR DURING THE TIMING CHECK. THE SLEEVE MOVES WITHOUT WARNING WHEN THE SYSTEM IS PRESSURISED. 11. Confirm the deployment and stow times are within the unchanged limits. 12. Do the reverser lock check and confirm the sleeve is stowed and locked.
sections.close_out: Record the shim selection at each station, the seal part number and the measured deployment and stow times in the reverser life record. Confirm the reverser is stowed and locked before the aircraft is released, and update the reverser cycle count baseline for the new seal standard.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The shim selection table for the high temperature seal applies only to aircraft post MOD-149010.

doors: Thrust reverser, shop and on wing

safety_precautions: Keep the reverser deployment area clear during the timing check.
Confirm the sleeve is secure in the shop stand before work starts.
Do not stand in the sleeve travel path on wing.
